room-101--the-big-payback.description: The Big Payback is a Nicaraguan puro from Matt Booth's Room101, with wrapper, binder and filler all grown in Nicaragua. Red pepper and leather lead the opening, lifted by citrus and a little espresso, before caramel and cedar soften the middle and a gentle, fig-like sweetness rounds out a leathery finish.

thirds.notes: A sharp red pepper start over leather and cocoa, lifted by grapefruit-like citrus and a hint of espresso.
The smoke mellows: leather leads, caramel and cedar emerge, and the pepper sits further back.
Leather and cedar share the front with cream and a light fig sweetness as the pepper all but fades.

room-101--farce-connecticut.description: Farce Connecticut is the mildest of Room101's Farce blends, rolled at Tabacalera William Ventura in the Dominican Republic. An Ecuadorian Connecticut-shade wrapper covers an Indonesian binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Smooth and easygoing, it shows cashew, honey and cedar over cream, with a light white pepper on the retrohale; a fitting morning cigar.

thirds.notes: Cashew and cream with a honeyed sweetness and light white pepper through the nose.
The cream builds and cedar steps forward, while honey and pepper stay in balance.
Cream leads into a sweet, gently spicy finish, with cedar and oak on the retrohale.

sources.title: Smoke Inn – Room 101 FARCE Connecticut

room-101--farce-nicaragua.description: Farce Nicaragua is Room101's Nicaraguan puro version of the Farce, made at Joya de Nicaragua rather than in the Dominican factory behind the original. Sweet cocoa, toffee-like notes and black pepper open the smoke with cream and a touch of citrus; walnut and dark chocolate fill the middle before the pepper rises again late.

thirds.notes: Sweet cocoa and toffee over firm black pepper, with cream, light coffee and orange peel.
Dark chocolate and toffee take the lead, with walnut and a base of black coffee.
Pepper sharpens beside the dark chocolate, while a creamy undertone and a little citrus keep it balanced.

sources.title: Tiny Tim's Cigar Blog – Room101 Farce Nicaragua Robusto

room-101--farce-habano.description: The original Farce from Room101 is rolled at Tabacalera William Ventura in the Dominican Republic, with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over an Indonesian binder and a filler of Dominican, Nicaraguan and Pennsylvania tobacco. Black pepper and spice open over cedar and bark, give way to honey and cocoa, and finish woody and nutty.

thirds.notes: Black pepper and bold spice over cedar and bark, with a savoury, slightly mineral edge.
Cocoa and honey move forward with spice, brown sugar and a light floral thread.
Wood and nuts come through as the savoury notes fade, with cedar, cashew and a touch of vanilla.

room-101--farce-maduro.description: Farce Maduro is Room101's darker take on the Farce: a Mexican San Andrés maduro wrapper over an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder, with Nicaraguan and US-grown filler that includes Pennsylvania Broadleaf and Connecticut leaf. Made in the Dominican Republic, it brings cocoa, espresso and oak with black pepper and a buttery leather note.

room-101--johnny-tobacconaut.description: Johnny Tobacconaut is a Nicaraguan puro from Matt Booth's Room101. It starts sweet and lightly herbal, with clove, milk chocolate, cedar and a trace of orange zest, then builds spice and cocoa through the middle, and closes creamy and full of flavour as the body rises.

thirds.notes: Sweet and herbal, with clove, milk chocolate, orange zest and cedar over subtle spice.
Spice returns and cocoa deepens as the body picks up.
The full range comes back: chocolate, red pepper, cream and coffee with dark cherry and raisin.

sources.title: Luxury Cigar Club – Room101 cigars guide

room-101--hit-run.description: Hit & Run is a Room101 blend rolled at Tabacalera William Ventura in the Dominican Republic. It begins light and sweet, with cream, almond and orange citrus over white pepper, moves into fresh cedar, brown sugar and an occasional flash of cinnamon, and ends darker, stronger and more peppery.

thirds.notes: Light and sweet, with cream, almond and orange citrus over a soft white pepper.
Cedar and nuttiness grow, the sweetness turns to brown sugar and cinnamon shows now and then.
The smoke darkens and gains strength, moving into heartier pepper.
